name: cli-prototype-public-share
description: M19 A3 (X-rider W3) capability fixture: after a preview is exposed on the LAN, the agent calls `make_preview_public` (relayed through the reserved `__preview` server to the FixtureTunnelBroker), gets a PUBLIC https URL back, and emits the prototype-ready ritual card — which now carries an 'Open the public link' button pointing at that public URL alongside the LAN 'Open preview' button. Locks the public-verb ritual-card shape end-to-end through inbound->router->runner->outbound->delivery. The make_public approval round-trip itself is covered by A3's host-handler + tunnel.rs unit tests; this fixture models the post-approval reply.
